(2) The hand continues its rhythmic stroking across the cat's head and ears, showcasing the animal's relaxed demeanor. In the background, a white wall is decorated with a festive 'MERRY CHRISTMAS' banner featuring gingerbread men characters. (3) The camera remains completely static at an eye-level perspective. The bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene clearly, and the TV screen in the background displays blurry content throughout the interaction.
